Prioritize Workers & Pages; use `wrangler`. Start with:
npx wrangler generate my-worker --type=module --ts
npx create-cloudflare@latest my-fullstack-app --framework next
Use pnpm/yarn workspaces. Use `.dev.vars` for local development.
❌ BAD: Storing sensitive data directly in code or `.env` files that aren't `.dev.vars`.
❌ BAD: Relying on global variables for user sessions or shared data.
Design for stateless Workers, stateful Durable Objects; use KV, D1, Durable Objects. Always use R2 for large file storage. Securely expose internal services without opening firewall ports; integrate SSO.
